title: OTR TAX NOTICE 2019 06 003 002 002
text:
GOVERNMENT OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
OFFICE OF THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
OFFICE OF TAX AND REVENUE
October 1, 2023
OTR TAX NOTICE 2023-06
NOTICE REGARDING REVISED FORM FP-7C
The Recorder of Deeds of the District of Columbia hereby gives notice that form FP-7/C, Real
Property Recordation and Transfer Tax Form, has been recently revised and that this revision
supersedes all prior versions of the form. Beginning October 15, 2023, only the latest version of
Form FP-7/C (ROD Form 1) – marked as revised 10/2023 - may be submitted to this office.
All prior versions of the FP-7/C are declared obsolete as of October 15, 2023 and will not be
accepted by the Recorder of Deeds. Persons preparing this form are advised to download it from
the Recorder of Deeds website to ensure that the most current version is being used.
For additional information, please contact OTR's Customer Service Center at (202) 727-4TAX
(4829) or the Recorder of Deeds at (202) 727-5374.
